conceito:
Use case stylized-concept. Create a NORMAL HAND PAINTED environment concept drawing, NOT pixel art, for the interior of a natural underground cavern in a top-down action RPG. This is architectural reference for rebuilding a currently poor cave level, so believable spatial construction is the highest priority.
Wide landscape composition, view from elevated near-overhead three-quarter camera, roof cut away. Show one coherent continuous cavern landscape: a roomy roughly oval central fighting chamber about 25 meters wide, another smaller chamber northwest, a narrow curving passage exiting east, a wider tunnel entering southwest, and a side chamber northeast with a dark turquoise subterranean pool. Walkable floor is natural compact sediment and uneven broad slate sheets, NOT tiled pavement, NOT flat cracked asphalt. Walls must be massive irregular rock formations with thickness, protruding buttresses, broad strata, concave corners, and shadowed recesses; show their vertical faces rising from the actual ground up to an irregular rim. Surround chambers with dark unexcavated rock so they visibly read as rooms UNDERGROUND, never outdoor pathways cut into a stone carpet. Maintain continuous floor-wall contact, top surfaces visibly distinct from side faces, organic transitions and natural openings at tunnels, no abrupt sliced strips. Stalagmites grow naturally in small clusters at wall feet, with a few low broken stones, tangled thin roots hanging from roof near southwest entrance. A few dim cyan mushrooms only in moist wall niches, understated. Cold gray-brown stone, muted slate floor, deep shadow recesses, soft warm shaft of daylight entering southwest tunnel. Water sits BELOW rock shore, no green grass, no outdoor trees, no grass ledges, no stone arches built by people, no mine carts, no random statues, no neon crystal spam. Include a tiny neutral human silhouette in central clearing only as scale reference. Ground free enough for battles. A crafted readable game environment design drawing, broad painterly shapes, thoughtful light, physically convincing architecture. No text, no labels, no UI, no grid. This is a normal painted drawing rather than pixel sprites.

Use case style-transfer. FIRST image is the exact environment composition and architectural structure to transform. SECOND image is a native Mana Seed game tile atlas, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Convert FIRST painted cavern into polished 16-bit PIXEL ART environmental reference for AlgoLand. Preserve its connected organic chambers, central fighting chamber, northwest room, northeast water chamber, southwest entrance and east passage. Preserve thick enclosing rock masses and visually continuous VERTICAL WALL FACES with wall feet grounded, distinct dark upper stone rims, shadow pockets and organic inside/outside corners. Do NOT reduce it to flat pathways pasted onto a rock texture. 
Actual crisp low-resolution pixel art, restrained color palette, clean 2-4 native-pixel color clusters, no smooth painterly brushes, no fine noisy detail. Elevated TOP-DOWN RPG view, more overhead than isometric, similar to SECOND reference. Reference logical canvas about768x512 shown2x nearest neighbor, native wall height about32px, neutral reference adventurer about16px tall; actual game will rebuild with16x16tiles and34pxactor. Warm muted gray-brown rock, earthy tan clear floor with sparse broad stone slabs, deep subdued blue underground pool with a mineral shore. Simple natural stalagmites grow at wall feet, roots hang near entrance, small cyan fungi in 2-3 niches. Clear playable ground and entrances. Outer rock should fade into near-black with very subtle variation, NEVER a repeated carpet of large rock tiles. Match the accepted native reference's pixel shape language and selective colored outlines, WITHOUT grass or trees. Keep walls built from coherent large rock forms, not tiny repeating brickwork, no stone paving/asphalt, no flowers, no mine carts. No thick black outline around objects, no colored alpha halos. No text UI labels or grid. Complete readable GAME ENVIRONMENT PIXEL ART REFERENCE, not a spritesheet, no antialias. Output landscape.

Remove a broad section of that separating rock at the pool chamber's southwest corner and make a clear dry mineral shelf/tunnel that joins the central floor to the pool shore, with natural continuous wall returns on BOTH sides. Expand the narrow connection between central room and northwest chamber into an unambiguous opening of continuous earthen floor, bounded by the same thick natural cave walls. Also ensure the southwest warmly lit entrance chamber connects directly to the central chamber by a clear floor neck, NOT by a closed wall or merely touching room silhouettes. All 4 chambers and the eastern exit form ONE continuous underground space. Keep large open fighting area centrally, retain surrounding near-black unexcavated rock, no isolated floating rooms, no straight rectangular floor patches pasted over walls, no detached wall strips. No text, no arrows, no grids. Do not add new props. Pixel art only, same restrained Mana Seed compatible style as input.
